data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Daumaa refers to Aisha bint Abu Bakr, who was a beloved wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This name signifies the strength and courage of the mothers of the believers, inspiring faith and devotion. The name Daumaa carries the meaning “Mother of the believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daumaa usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Daumaa carries a deep spiritual connotation, reminding us of the strength, courage, faith, and dedication of Aisha bint Abu Bakr (R.A.), who remains an inspiring figure for Muslim women around the world.
